meta.title: Edit Evaluation Time: Enter an excessively large future date for evaluation end time

plan.title: Edit Evaluation Time with Excessive Future Date

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ summary with its existing vendor bid.
Navigate to the RFQ stage where the evaluation-time settings action is available.
Open the RFQ's Edit Evaluation Time window.
Confirm the expected evaluation-time dialog opened.

args.goal: In the Edit Evaluation Time dialog, choose the custom duration option, enter an excessively large future evaluation end date of 31 December 2100 23:59, click Ok, and record the application's resulting refusal, validation message, or saved outcome on screen

steps.note: Perform and observe the date-specific interaction that no structured catalog step can parameterize.
Confirm the resulting screen has no crash, server error, or malformed values.
